keywords: Denmark, Greenland, Arctic security, sovereignty, NATO, Novo Nordisk, pharmaceutical dependency, Danish economy, HICP inflation, Nationalbanken, defence spending, EU economics, Arctic shipping, Danish politics
notes: Denmark is accelerating its military presence in Greenland while simultaneously grappling with an economy that is unusually reliant on a single pharmaceutical giant. Both developments carry consequences well beyond Copenhagen, touching NATO strategy, EU economic resilience, and the daily lives of ordinary Danes. The country's headline numbers look strong, but beneath the surface lie structural fault lines that policymakers can no longer afford to ignore.
